text: Agent Cartsmith Coupon Stacking Policy. You may combine exactly one manufacturer coupon and one store coupon per item per transaction. Digital coupons clipped through the Agent Cartsmith app combine freely with paper coupons on the same item, as long as no more than one of each type (manufacturer + store) is applied. The Club Card / member price is always applied first, before any coupons are deducted, so coupons come off the already-discounted member price. Loyalty points redeem at the rate of $1 in savings per 100 points, and point redemptions do not stack with competitor ad-match pricing on the same item. In short: one manufacturer coupon plus one store coupon per item; digital (Agent Cartsmith) and paper coupons combine; member price applies before coupons; points redeem at $1 per 100 points and cannot be combined with competitor ad-match.

Recipe: Spaghetti Bolognese (serves 4). Ingredients: Barilla Spaghetti (1 box), Rao's Homemade Marinara Sauce (1 jar), Signature Farms Ground Beef 80/20 (1 lb), Johnsonville Italian Sausage (1/2 lb), BelGioioso Grated Parmesan Cheese (to taste), Bertolli Extra Virgin Olive Oil (2 tbsp), Hunt's Whole Peeled Tomatoes (1 can), Fresh Garlic Bulb (3 cloves), Yellow Onion (1 medium), Signature Select Italian Bread (1 loaf, for serving). Steps: 1) Heat the olive oil in a large pan over medium heat. Dice the yellow onion and mince the garlic, then saute until fragrant and translucent. 2) Add the ground beef and Italian sausage (casing removed); brown thoroughly, breaking it up with a spoon. 3) Stir in the canned tomatoes and marinara sauce; simmer 25-30 minutes until thickened. 4) Meanwhile, cook the spaghetti in salted boiling water until al dente, then drain. 5) Toss the pasta with the sauce, top with grated parmesan, and serve with warm Italian bread. Pairs well with a side salad of O Organics Baby Spinach.

Agent Cartsmith Loyalty Program Overview. Members earn 1 point for every $1 spent on qualifying purchases. Earn 2x points every Friday and 3x points on select featured items highlighted in the weekly ad. Tier benefits: Member is the free base tier. Silver (reached at 1,000 lifetime points) unlocks 5% off fuel at participating stations. Gold (5,000 lifetime points) adds free delivery on orders over $30. Platinum (10,000 lifetime points) adds a dedicated personal shopper plus all lower-tier perks. Points redeem at a rate of $1 in grocery savings per 100 points and can be applied at checkout in-store, on delivery, or via curbside pickup.

Agent Cartsmith Return Policy. Most items may be returned within 30 days of purchase with a valid receipt for a full refund to the original payment method. Returns without a receipt may be issued as store credit at the manager's discretion. Perishable exception: fresh produce, meat, seafood, dairy, and bakery items can be returned at any time if you are not satisfied with their quality (the freshness guarantee), even without the 30-day window, and refunds for perishables are typically issued as a refund or replacement on the spot. Alcohol, gift cards, and prescription items are non-returnable where prohibited by law.

Fresh Produce Sourcing and Freshness Guide. Our O Organics and Signature Farms produce is sourced from regional Pacific Northwest, Mountain West, and California growers to minimize transit time and maximize freshness. Strawberries and bananas are stocked daily; choose strawberries that are bright red with fresh green caps and store them unwashed in the refrigerator. Baby spinach and mixed greens are best used within 5-7 days; keep them dry and refrigerated. Yellow onions and garlic should be stored in a cool, dry, well-ventilated spot away from potatoes, which last longest in a dark pantry. Roma tomatoes ripen best at room temperature and should only be refrigerated once fully ripe. All fresh produce is covered by our freshness guarantee under the return policy.

Recipe: Quick Weeknight Lemon Garlic Chicken (serves 4, about 30 minutes). Ingredients: Open Nature Boneless Chicken Breast (1.5 lb), Bertolli Extra Virgin Olive Oil (2 tbsp), Fresh Garlic Bulb (4 cloves), Fresh Lemon (1), Signature Select Long Grain White Rice (1 cup), O Organics Broccoli Florets (12 oz), salt and pepper to taste. Steps: 1) Cook the white rice per package directions. 2) Season the chicken breasts with salt and pepper. Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium-high and sear the chicken 5-6 minutes per side until cooked through. 3) Add minced garlic and the juice of one lemon to the pan; spoon over the chicken. 4) Steam or roast the broccoli florets until tender-crisp. 5) Serve the chicken and broccoli over the rice. A fast, in-stock weeknight dinner.
